slices.title: Decision records
slices.summary: Records the Spaces-as-chat-project decision: a ledger entry in the Model Plane decisions ledger, an addendum to the authored-instructions ADR, and OD19 and I21 marked superseded in the chat gap-closure plan. Docs only, no code.

slices.title: Space layer in Do runs
slices.summary: Tests only: a Do run in a project applies the Space instruction between the org layer and the persona when WS02's run-context switch is on, and a non-member gets no Space text. Adds one eval case. No new runtime switch; it rides MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTEXT, which WS02 owns.

slices.title: Follow-up turns keep Space retrieval authority
slices.summary: Follow-up turns in a Space carry a retrieval decision token, so turn 2 retrieves only inside the Space as turn 1 does. A FORBIDDEN decision on an append yields an empty token and an ungrounded answer, never an org-wide search. The BFF append branch calls the Control retrieval-decision endpoint, and the gateway reads the token from space_context or space_append_context.
slices.needs_external: DEC-06 D7 Space and Control acknowledgement before merge; DEC-28 merge acknowledgement; staging proof with a Space-only and an org-only document before the default-on flip (K3-18)
slices.flag: GATEWAY_SPACE_APPEND_RETRIEVAL (BFF env): default ON in every environment after the staging proof (K3-18); a kill switch only, where =false re-exposes org documents to shared threads

slices.title: Knowledge-mode receipt and badge
slices.summary: Adds an optional knowledge block (mode retrieval, not_entitled or not_searched, plus a source count) to the existing source_scope_applied SSE event, built by a pure knowledge_receipt function, and a knowledge chip on Space turns in the SPA. An absent block means today's behaviour; retrieval_notice is not reused.

slices.title: Project picker, chip, project thread list
slices.summary: Adds an opt-in Projects section above the chat organizer that lists eligible Spaces (personal Spaces and non-organization rooms), with a project picker, a Space chip, a first-send audience confirm, and a project thread list. Project chats start as new chats, reuse the existing /api/v1/spaces routes, and stay behind GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED (default off).
depends_on: EP-8 slice 1 (Dreaming exclusion of space threads, K3-5)
slices.needs_external: DEC-28 D1-D4 and DEC-06 D5 owner rulings; EP-8 slice 1 Dreaming exclusion (owned outside WS18, K3-5)
slices.flag: GATEWAY_CHAT_PROJECTS_ENABLED (default off; staging on). Stays off until Dreaming excludes threads.space_id not null or origin in (space, agent_run), with test space_thread_messages_never_reach_user_memory (K3-5)

slices.title: Do runs retrieve from the project
slices.summary: Do runs in a project forward a Space retrieval authorization from model-gateway to execution-core so knowledge_search runs Space-scoped. A Space-scoped run without a token gets a typed 'project knowledge unavailable' tool error, never an unscoped search. Behind AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED (default off, where off is today's unscoped Do search).
slices.flag: AGENTIC_SPACE_RETRIEVAL_ENABLED (gateway env, default off; off = today's unscoped Do search); enablement gated by the WS18-D8 decision-TTL measurement
